personality_one_liner: A cinematic, deeply atmospheric, and premium super app where rich dark navy surfaces meet warm glowing amber accents and frosted glass.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing. Utilize negative space to make the dark navy surfaces feel vast and premium. Never cramp elements.

do's: Use glass on sticky headers, bottom tab bars, bottom-sheet handles, floating action buttons (FABs), and featured hero cards.
Pair the blur with a translucent tinted base (≥75% of surface) underneath to guarantee readability in dark mode.
Ensure text on top of glass uses onSurface and has maximum contrast.
dont's: Never apply glass to standard form fields, body text regions, or basic list rows.
Never rely on blur alone without the underlying tint layer.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: The cinematic central hub offering personalized content and immediate access to Flash AI.

states.loading: Centered sleek amber spinner against deep navy background.
states.empty: Abstract dark imagery with a gentle prompt to start exploring.
states.error: Soft error message with a prominent 'Retry' button in amber.

screens.layout: Top greeting in serif typography + circular avatar. A large hero card featuring a stunning Tashkent night photo with a vertical gradient scrim, overlaid with personalized AI suggestions. A horizontal scroll of glass-layered quick shortcuts. A vertical list of 'For You' recommendations on elevated surfaceSecondary cards.

screens.name: Flash AI
screens.purpose: A premium, minimal conversational interface where the AI acts as a sophisticated executive assistant.

states.empty: A clean dark canvas with a single warm 'How can I assist you today?' greeting.
states.error: Minimal inline error text with retry icon.

screens.layout: Clean iOS-native top header. Near-black chat canvas. User bubbles are right-aligned with subtle surfaceSecondary fill; AI replies are left-aligned on the main surface. Action confirmation cards are rendered as rich glass components with a brandPrimary CTA. Bottom neumorphic input bar anchored to the keyboard.

screens.name: Explore
screens.purpose: A visually driven directory of places prioritizing large imagery and typography.

states.loading: Skeleton UI matching the large image cards.
states.empty: Premium dark abstract state indicating no places found.

screens.layout: Sticky search bar and horizontal filter chips over scrolling content using expo-blur. Single-column, edge-to-edge image cards. Each card has a full-bleed photo, a 3-stop vertical gradient scrim (transparent to 80% surfaceInverse), with the title and rating sitting in the bottom 30%.

screens.name: News
screens.purpose: An elegant, editorial-style reading experience for global and local Uzbekistan news.

states.empty: No news available, stylized empty state illustration.
states.error: Readable message with a retry button.

screens.layout: Glassy sticky header with horizontal category chips. The top story is a large hero image card with serif headlines. Subsequent stories are horizontal list items with a right-aligned square thumbnail, title, and a small glass badge for 'AI Summary'.

screens.name: My Life
screens.purpose: A calm, structured utility space for plans, saved places, and reminders.

states.empty: Premium dark abstract illustration + soft prompt to create the first plan/reminder.

screens.layout: Top glassy segmented control (Plans | Reminders | Saved). Vertical list of items on sleek surfaceSecondary cards. Each item features a prominent left-aligned icon in a brandTertiary container and an action chevron.

screens.name: Auth
screens.purpose: A high-end cinematic entry point for user login and guest access.

states.loading: Button shows loading state during auth.
states.error: Inline red validation text below inputs.

screens.layout: Full-bleed dark Tashkent hero background with heavy gradient overlay. Bottom-anchored glass sheet for auth. Email/Password inputs with labels above, a primary CTA in brandPrimary, and a subtle secondary text link for Guest access.

instructions_to_main_agent: Load custom fonts `Playfair Display` (serif, display) and `Manrope` (sans-serif, text) from TTF files using `expo-font`. Ensure these fonts support Cyrillic characters as Russian is the default language.

Do NOT use `@expo-google-fonts` packages. You must provide instructions or a script to download the TTF files (e.g., via a bash script pulling from Google Fonts zip) or mock them if actual files cannot be downloaded, but they must be loaded via local file references.
Implement a bottom tab navigator with 4 main tabs (Home, Explore, News, Life).
Flash AI must be a full-screen route (modal or stack screen), accessible via a prominent FAB or a central action button.
Strictly enforce the gradient-to-dark scrim pattern on all images that have text overlaid. The gradient must be vertical, transparent to ≥70% surfaceInverse.

Glassmorphism must be used on the bottom tab bar, sticky headers, bottom-sheet handles, and featured hero cards. In dark mode, ensure the translucent tinted base under the blur is at least 75% opacity to guarantee text readability.
Create a hidden Admin dashboard accessible via tapping a version number or specific hidden sequence in the Profile section.
Ensure all copy and placeholders reflect the premium, executive assistant tone.
Use Phosphor icons consistently. Stick to one weight per screen (except active/inactive states in the tab bar).
